name: app_mcp_read
description: Uses a program's own MCP server that the node operator listed (Programmable App MCPs). Without tool and schema it lists the program's tools and version; with schema it returns one tool's input schema; with tool it runs a tool the operator marked read-only. Answers are bounded text pages; images only on request.

program.description: Program id the node operator listed for app MCPs, for example filmcraft.

tool.description: Tool name of the program's own MCP server, from the app_mcp_read listing.

schema.description: Tool name whose input schema to return.

arguments.description: Arguments for the program's tool, as its schema describes them.

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long text answer at next_offset.

max_chars.description: Most characters of text to return; default 4000.

images.description: Return up to two images of the answer; images are omitted by default.

node.description: Registered node identifier; URLs are not accepted.
